usageNotes: Use this to initialize a raw block device as an LVM Volume Group (VG) on a specific node — a prerequisite before any LVM-backed or LVM-thin storage can be added. The target device must be unpartitioned and not in use; Proxmox will wipe it and create a new PV+VG. Returns a task UPID string (async); poll the task to confirm completion before using the new VG. Set add_storage=true to simultaneously register the VG as a Proxmox storage entry, which additionally requires Datastore.Allocate on /storage.

examples.summary: Create a VG named 'data-vg' on /dev/sdb and auto-register it as a storage pool

tips: The device path must be an absolute block device path (e.g. /dev/sdb, /dev/nvme0n1) — partitions like /dev/sdb1 may be rejected.
If the disk has existing partition tables or LVM metadata, Proxmox will refuse to create the VG; wipe it first via the disk wipe endpoint (POST /nodes/{node}/disks/wipe).
The 'name' field follows pve-storage-id format: alphanumeric plus hyphens, no spaces.
If you omit add_storage, you must manually add the storage via the storage API (POST /storage) after the task completes.
